_comment: gobo bridge config, read once at bridge startup. Editor calls (artnet(), sacn(), osc(), mock()) override these values at runtime. See the DMX output configuration section of the README.
_comment_host: artnet.host: 127.0.0.1 only reaches software on THIS machine. For hardware, use your subnet broadcast (e.g. 192.168.1.255, reaches every node) or one node's IP (e.g. 192.168.1.50, unicast and quieter). Check which subnet the lighting network is on; Art-Net gear is often 2.x.x.x or 10.x.x.x rather than 192.168.x.x.
